message.spacing: {{component}} owns spacing. Use a size prop (Button: sm, marketing, md, lg, icon, icon-xs, icon-sm, icon-md, icon-lg, icon-xl; Input: sm, md, lg) instead of padding or height. Upstream {{sizes}} suggestions may be empty because Button/Input sizes are spread from contract maps into cva.
message.color: {{component}} owns color. Use an approved variant ({{variants|none defined}}) from @jovie/ui.
message.typography: {{component}} owns typography. Use an approved variant ({{variants|none defined}}) instead of font/text restyles.
message.shape: {{component}} owns radius/shape. Use an approved variant ({{variants|none defined}}) instead of rounded-* overrides.
message.default: Do not restyle {{component}}. Use approved @jovie/ui variants ({{variants|none defined}}) and sizes ({{sizes|none defined}}). Layout/placement classes are allowed. See DESIGN.md.
